head_in_frame.why: the face is the subject of a close-up; cropping the crown or snout reads as a framing mistake

hero_not_blown.why: when most hero dots hit full brightness the figure becomes a white cloud and the shape is lost

hero_moon_readable.why: a bright figure over the bright moon merges; either keep them apart or make the figure a dark silhouette on the moon

hero_size.why: subject must be big enough to read on a phone and not fill everything

hero_not_cropped.why: outside intentional close-ups the figure should not be cut by the frame edge

caption_clear_of_hero.why: captions may cross the lower body but must not hide most of the figure

camera_zoom_rate.why: zooms faster than this feel like jolts, not moves

camera_pan_rate.why: pans faster than this smear the dot field

caption_clear_of_face.why: a caption over the face destroys the emotional beat of a close-up

subject_in_frame.why: the protagonist (even if only a point of light) must be on screen and not hugging the edge

formation_visible.why: when the formation is the story, at least a quarter of its dots must be in frame or the audience cannot see it

frame_not_dark.why: a near-black frame mid-film reads as a render failure

frame_not_blown.why: bloom or glow washing out more than 10% of the frame loses all dot structure

story_subjects_visible.why: anything the narration is talking about at that moment must be on screen; otherwise the visual contradicts the words

caption_in_margins.why: Reels UI and phone bezels crop the edges; captions need a safe side margin

caption_legible.why: bright dots, rings or glow under caption text make it unreadable on a phone even when the average backdrop is dark
